232-678-3967.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

5078-6918-7297-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

277-2292-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2292-2577-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-1052-6553.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5256-6097.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4153-5686--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4153-5686--5--195.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3525-3755-7937.description:
Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

1887-2021-2060-7704.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

215-1849-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-1849-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-4245-5003-7649.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Thorin, adding {C}{C}.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Vrondiss, and then having it deal damage to itself.
Vrondiss triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

5058-5256-7422.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-2034-4294-7115.description:
Cast Etali either from your hand or the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

628-5147-7211.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

6797-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

671-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
671-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6664-7060.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-6664-7060.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1829-3944-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blood Pet ability.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1796-2060-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

934-3129-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3858-4827.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 19 or higher.
3858-4827.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers. Holding priority, activate Evra by paying {4}, exchanging its  power with your life total.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

141-6475-6798.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

225-1170-3389-5954-6751.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-3389-5954-6751.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Trade Caravan

1025-3927-6658.notablePrerequisites:
One of Trade Caravan or Sakashima's Protege has a currency counter on it.
You control a basic Island.
1025-3927-6658.description:
During your upkeep, Stasis, Trade Caravan and Sakashima's Protege trigger.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Resolve the Trade Caravan and Sakashima's Protege triggers, putting a currency counter on each of them.
During an opponent's upkeep, activate either Trade Caravan or Sakashima's Protege by removing two currency counters from it, untapping a basic Island.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sea Gate Restoration // Sea Gate, Reborn

1561-3096-6624.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1561-3096-6624.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw half your library and lose half your life total, rounding up each time.
Cast Sea Gate Restoration by paying {4}{U}{U}{U}, causing you to draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your hand. When you attempt to draw from an empty library this way, you will win the game due to Jace.

413-3055-6553.easyPrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
413-3055-6553.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

804-2034-2533-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

5803-5892.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5803-5892.description:
Cast Rustler Rampage by paying {1}{W}, choosing the first mode.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Rustler Rampage.
Resolve the copy of Rustler Rampage, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.

293-3967-5220-5716.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni, Undying Partisan ability from step 1, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

4050-5660-5713.description:
Cast Iron Apprentice by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Iron Apprentice, adding {1}.
When Iron Apprentice dies, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Iron Apprentice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

504-686-914.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
504-686-914.description:
Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Razor Hippogriff and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.
Activate Cold Storage by sacrificing it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Razor Hippogriff from exile to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist and Razor Hippogriff enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least ten Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Razor Hippogriff trigger, returning Cold Storage from your graveyard to your hand and causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}.
Cast Cold Storage by paying {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control eleven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1746-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Accomplished Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

126-481-1173.notablePrerequisites: You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
126-481-1173.description:
Cast Final Fortune by paying {R}{R}.
Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Final Fortune from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding priority, activate Obeka by tapping it, ending the turn and exiling the Final Fortune trigger from the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

2104-4300-4423.notablePrerequisites: Meloku on the battlefield.You control three Islands.
2104-4300-4423.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

2130-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and target creature, and causing you to gain life equal to the total amount of damage done this way.

1328-1494-4017-4996.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Sage of Hours.Spellbinder attached to a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Your life total is at least 5.
1328-1494-4017-4996.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, casting a copy of Beacon of Immortality without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Beacon of Immortality, doubling your life total.
Sage of Hours triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
